definitions.t0: first GT sample with any speed_mps > 0.03
definitions.distance: centre-to-centre from GT x/y, all pairs, t >= t0 for the episode minimum
definitions.recede_window: first recede dispatch (m4 received, else m5) to cross-phase dispatch (m5)
definitions.starts_receding: first GT sample >= reference time where hypot(x,y) exceeds its value at the last sample <= reference time by more than 0.05 m; common_ref = first recede dispatch (used for who moved first), own_ref = the robot's own recede dispatch
definitions.first_finish: last GT sample between the first receder's start and the second recede dispatch with speed_mps > 0.03; m5 'resolved status' of the first recede command is also recorded
definitions.overlap: second receder own_ref start earlier than first receder's last moving sample; no tolerance applied
definitions.wall_to_sim: dispatch sim times are INFERRED via m5_scene.jsonl (t vs scene stamp) anchored at the 'starting analysis request=' log line vs the artifact snapshot stamp; error about a few tenths of a sim-second; GT start times are exact GT samples
definitions.phase_fallback: artifacts lacking junction_phases (Oct bundles): phase commands recovered from <request_id>-junction-{recede-<robot>,cross,release} ids in m4/m5 logs
definitions.chi_source: per_analysis.jsonl chi_order by request_id, cross-checked against frozen scorer chi_pair (summary episodes.jsonl or ib10_score.json) when its artifact matches
